audio.name: Dialogue and Foley
audio.description: The model speaks the lines in the cast voices and renders room tone and Foley. Needs voices from /cast. Never music.
audio.prompt: Audio: the spoken dialogue in the referenced voices, natural room tone and Foley for every action on screen. No music, no score, no subtitles.

camera.name: Animated, storybook camera
camera.description: Best for animated, children's, fairy tale.
camera.prompt: A virtual animation camera with a 35mm feel: soft depth of field, smooth glides and gentle parallax between layers, compositions framed like picture-book spreads.
